augmentation.scope: Exactly one deterministic horizontal flip per source train image, after place-code group assignment. No online or validation/test augmentation.

initialization: All three architectures use shape-compatible YOLO11n COCO checkpoint transfer; new layers random. Seed set before construction and training.
selection: Best Bijie validation fitness = .1*mAP50 + .9*mAP50-95, never MLD validation or test.
evaluation: All nine trainings finish before MLD evaluation; source val/test and unchanged MLD test. FP32,640,batch8,conf.001,iou.7,max_det300,no TTA.
scope: Public source stage for baseline and CTPA teacher only; current SF is defined by compression protocol. Archived code hashes identify the original execution, not the portable entry point.
split_basis: Author-confirmed place-name prefixes grouped; df and zdf conservatively co-assigned. Count-only split selection, not coordinate-buffered site verification.
